verdict.rationale: Zero documents no sandbox or test mode that lets a user or agent exercise its MCP or email actions without touching real mailbox data. The MCP surface works against the live session via a copied browser cookie. Self-hosting, devcontainer setup, the local `pnpm go` dev database and Drizzle Studio are contributor tooling and user-side workarounds, not a product sandbox, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
